title: August and the Spire
author: Lior Winterbourne
blurb: Marguerite Quintana, a bone-carver who hears the dead, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
